summary.overview:
- Riccardo Termini, based in Sicily, owns Agent Incubator focusing on real estate agents and has transitioned from Facebook to Google Ads for better lead quality.
- The business serves 43 active clients with package pricing ranging from $4,000 to $10,500, averaging $5,000-$7,000 per contract over 6-month programs.
- Agent Incubator's revenue for the last 12 months was $224,000, achieving a 75% profit margin, translating to $170,000 profit due to low overhead costs.
- Utilized a cost-effective 3-step outreach strategy (cold SMS, phone calls, Zoom calls), minimizing reliance on paid advertising.
- Business listed on acquire.com and flippa.com with an asking price of $150,000, willing to accept offers starting from $100,000, representing about a 1x profit multiple.
- Riccardo is selling to transition to investment banking and fitness community building, aiming for completion within 1-2 months.
- Capital A Group charges a $3,250 upfront fee plus a 10% success fee, with options for enhanced service packages.
- Discussions with potential buyer 'Simon' are active, although no offers have been made yet due to the recent listing.
- Riccardo's recent $20,000 investment in banking coaching has created temporary cash flow constraints but has scheduled renewal calls to improve this.
summary.short_summary: Riccardo Termini, owner of Agent Incubator in Sicily, is transitioning from a focus on Facebook to Google Ads to enhance lead quality. The business serves 43 active clients with packages priced between $4,000 to $10,500, averaging around $5,000-$7,000 for six-month contracts. Over the past year, Agent Incubator generated $224,000 in revenue with a 75% profit margin, resulting in a $170,000 profit due to low overhead costs. Riccardo employs a cost-effective outreach strategy involving cold SMS, phone calls, and Zoom calls, minimizing paid advertising reliance. The business is listed for sale on acquire.com and flippa.com at an asking price of $150,000, but offers starting from $100,000 are welcome, reflecting approximately a 1x profit multiple. Riccardo is selling to pivot towards investment banking and community building in fitness, aiming for a sale completion in 1-2 months. He has engaged in discussions with a potential buyer named Simon, while managing temporary cash flow constraints from a recent $20,000 investment in banking coaching.
